title: 부산광역시 북구와 사상구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:30037:20190813:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 부산광역시 북구와 사상구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 30037, August 13, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date 30 days after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.)
Any public notice, disposition or other act made, before this Decree enters into force, by the head of a former local government or the head of an agency under that head concerning an area incorporated into another local government's jurisdiction pursuant to this Decree shall be deemed a public notice, disposition or other act made by the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over the area pursuant to this Decree or the head of an agency under that head. Any application, report or other act made to the head of the former local government or to the head of an agency under that head shall be deemed to have been made to the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over the area pursuant to this Decree or the head of an agency under that head.

Article 3 (Relationship to Other Statutes or Regulations)
Where, at the time this Decree enters into force, an individual statute or regulation designates all or part of a self-governing district whose jurisdiction is changed by this Decree as an area or jurisdictional area, that statute or regulation shall, until it is amended after this Decree enters into force, apply by deeming the relevant area of the self-governing district changed by this Decree to remain within the area or jurisdictional area of the self-governing district to which it belonged before the change.
